summary: Hut 8 Corp. filed an 8-K on September 28, 2026 (event date September 24, 2026) disclosing entry into a senior secured revolving credit facility of up to $1,070.0 million, including a $1,070.0 million letter-of-credit sublimit, with JPMorgan Chase Bank as administrative and collateral agent. No amounts were drawn at closing; borrowings may be reborrowed until the fourth anniversary. Pricing is Adjusted Term SOFR plus 1.50%–2.00% (initially 1.750%) or ABR plus 0.50%–1.00% (initially 0.750%), tied to a debt-to-market-cap ratio. Obligations are guaranteed by restricted subsidiaries and secured by a first-priority lien on substantially all assets, with a minimum-liquidity covenant (40% of commitments pre-Stabilization, 25% after). This is a routine credit-facility financing, not a special situation; watch drawdowns and covenant headroom.
